e.title: Claims Risk Scoring Dataset (HF)
e.summary: HuggingFace 理赔风险评分训练数据集（BDR-AI）：索赔风险建模的现成数据
e.body: Claims Risk Scoring Training（gcc-insurance-ml-models，HuggingFace）是 BDR-AI 发布的理赔风险评分训练数据集：面向索赔风险建模（核赔/风险分层）的标注数据，可直接用于训练与评测。对 RIAA：HuggingFace 生态的保险数据入口——与 [[casdatasets]]（R 精算数据）、[[insuranceqa-corpus]]（保险问答语料）互补：前者偏建模教学、后者偏 NLP，此数据集偏风险评分建模；配合 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定价）做核赔风控实验；HF 数据集即开即用（datasets 库加载）。
e.verified_note: 数据集页核实：HuggingFace 确认（理赔风险评分训练数据，BDR-AI），未实测
e.summary_en: HuggingFace claims risk-scoring training dataset (BDR-AI): ready-made data for claims-risk modelling
e.summary_hk: HuggingFace 理賠風險評分訓練數據集（BDR-AI）：索賠風險建模的現成數據
e.body_en: Claims Risk Scoring Training (gcc-insurance-ml-models, HuggingFace) is a claims risk-scoring training dataset released by BDR-AI: labelled data for claims-risk modelling (adjudication/risk tiering), usable directly for training and evaluation. For RIAA: an insurance-data entry into the HuggingFace ecosystem — complementary to [[casdatasets]] (R actuarial data) and [[insuranceqa-corpus]] (insurance QA corpus): the former leans teaching, the latter NLP, while this one targets risk-scoring modelling; pair with [[machine-learning-pricing]] (ML pricing) for claims-adjudication risk experiments; HF datasets load out of the box via the datasets library.
e.body_hk: Claims Risk Scoring Training（gcc-insurance-ml-models，HuggingFace）是 BDR-AI 發佈的理賠風險評分訓練數據集：面向索賠風險建模（核賠/風險分層）的標註數據，可直接用於訓練與評測。對 RIAA：HuggingFace 生態的保險數據入口——與 [[casdatasets]]（R 精算數據）、[[insuranceqa-corpus]]（保險問答語料）互補：前者偏建模教學、後者偏 NLP，此數據集偏風險評分建模；配合 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定價）做核賠風控實驗；HF 數據集即開即用（datasets 庫加載）。
